node.title: Resultado upstream independiente
node.summary: Specify a service, continuity or capability result independently of local rule success.

relations: Cross-frame coherence is assessed against an independently specified upstream outcome, making the map–flow argument operational without equating every deviation with value.
No todo incumplimiento es coherencia y un objetivo del cliente puede ser inválido en un marco social o legal más amplio.
Process conformance identifies a path difference; outcome and counterfactual evidence are still needed to establish whether the deviation preserved the upstream result.
No canonizar heroísmos, fraude ni atajos inseguros por producir una salida local. El marco receptor debe permanecer explícito.
The team is an integrated system when its specialist decisions preserve the same independently stated mission outcome, not merely when every member completes a local deliverable.
La coherencia declarada por el equipo no sustituye aceptación del receptor ni autoriza infringir límites externos.
Functional trust can support early disclosure of uncertainty when protecting the mission requires giving up a locally favourable account of progress.
La confianza no prueba coherencia y el desacuerdo puede ser correcto; conservar canales de revisión y contraste independientes.
The UP move can expose alternatives outside a local frame, while an independently stated upstream outcome is needed to judge whether the new perspective is coherent.
Un cambio de perspectiva personal no prueba coherencia ni autoriza a imponer un objetivo elegido por el facilitador.
The rejected turnstile is a field example of why control value must include its effect on the operating flow, alongside the work and risk it removes.
El caso no prueba la curva de carga de oversight ni convierte todo control físico o humano en deuda.
The same network can contain harmful local optimization and useful off-map adaptation; their sign becomes clear only after the upstream outcome and its recipient are specified.
La lectura está expresamente propuesta en la fuente; no elimina las obligaciones de seguridad, derechos o legitimidad del servicio.
Good-enough occupancy is decision-specific: evidence sufficient for coordination must be requalified before it is reused for accounting, enforcement or another commitment.
No se deriva del test contract un umbral numérico de precisión para Tuxpan ni una garantía de seguridad del conteo.
Reach-weighted latency can operationalize one aspect of informational friction, but the causal loss from a divergent map must still be separated from necessary waiting and other delays.
No se identifica algebraicamente F con la magnitud teórica ni se interpreta todo retraso como ineficiencia.
Off-path frequency is a screening measure; load-bearing positive deviation requires evidence that the upstream outcome depended on that path.
La dependencia causal requiere más que conformance checking y no se obtiene suponiendo positiva toda excepción exitosa.
Industrial delivery is complete only when the composed chain supports customer production readiness; passing each local control does not establish that end-to-end outcome.
El paralelo no afirma que el caso utilizara la arquitectura EA ni atribuye a ésta las mejoras comerciales reportadas.
The territorial dimension makes the frame explicit: an operating outcome must be evaluated against the affected recipients and obligations, not only the contractor's local target.
La relación conceptual no verifica cumplimiento de derechos en un caso concreto ni otorga representación sobre comunidades.
Contribution measurement should separate the reference outcome, the evaluated decision process and the credit assigned, rather than feeding the desired verdict into the measurement.
Traslado metodológico; el cálculo del toy no acredita validez de un instrumento de atribución humana.
